question: Place Sikandara which comes under the suburb of Agra is associated with the tomb of________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Akbar**.__

__
 
• **Place Sikandara which comes under the suburb of Agra is associated with the tomb of Akbar.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Akbar's **tomb is located in Sikandra Agra.
 
• Its construction was started by Akbar in 1605 and completed by Jahangir.
 
• Sikandra was named/related to sikander Lodi.
 
• This is a beautiful five-story tomb.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• The Buland Darwaza of the Mughal period is located in Fatehpur Sikri.
 
• Mathura is famous as being the birthplace of Lord Krishna.
 
• Moradabad is famous as Brass city.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

 
• Akbar was one of the mightiest emperors during the Mughal Era.
 
• He was born in October 1542 and died on 27th October 1605.
 
• Akbar was the third Mughal Emperor.
 
• His reign was between 1556-1605 AD.
 
• He was crowned in 1556, at the young age of thirteen years.
 
• He was assisted by Barram Khan.
 
• He is known for his liberal religious policies, relationship with Indian kings, conquests, etc.
 
• In 1564, he abolished the jizyah tax levied on non-muslims.​​
